data.body: Addressed all four patch-set-1 LLM advisories in patch set 3 (70319740c7). Major compatibility finding fixed in scope: canonical rendering now applies only to preview/sync, so route=legacy bootstrap retains outbound/inbound manifest shape; regression was RED first. Exact canonical tally now uses actually dispatched inbound plus post-suppression outbound candidates; suppressed-inbound regression was RED first. Added capped canonical sync coverage (plan/counts/max_changes/deferred) and missing/corrupt batch-manifest fallback coverage. Validation: 30 focused compatibility tests, 279 bridge/orchestrator+complexity tests, lint, typecheck. Fetched origin/main immediately before push; behind count 0.
